def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Equação empírica para log10(|ID|/A) ao longo da curva de transferência."""
    # Intercept (y-intercept when gate voltage is zero)
    a = parameters[0]
    # Slope of the power-law relationship
    b = parameters[1]
    # Express the function: log10(|ID|/A) = a + b * gate_voltage_abs
    return a + b * gate_voltage_abs
